bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review evaluating how AI representations limit possible professional selves for women, either by reinforcing traditional roles (e.g., women as nurturers) or by promoting a narrow, homogenized archetype of female professional success.

Informal qualitative prompt testing using DALL-E (e.g., "Create an image of Iranian girls standing in front of their school in 2040") and analyzing the model's internal prompt expansions to observe how AI defaults to preserving current cultural and political status-quo norms (such as mandatory hijabs) while only imagining technological advancements.

Conceptual analysis drawing on system justification theory to evaluate how generative AI models and search summaries subtly nudge users toward narratives that defend existing power structures and the political status-quo.
